greetings.text: Looking to buy a pony? I've a few going cheap.
Strangers, strangers. Did I ask you to come in?

farewells.text: Off you go, then. Don't let the gate hit you.
Come back when you've got coin.

smalltalk.text: Rangers! A lot of vagabonds. Nobody asked them to watch our roads.
Hobbits are good for two things: ale and gossip. Bree'd be poorer without 'em, I'll grant.
Plenty of folk passing through. Plenty of coin, too, for them that knows how to talk.
Don't look at me like that. I'm an honest pony-dealer.

black_riders_asking_for_baggins.text: Black cloaks at the West-gate? Aye, so they say. I wouldn't know. Not my business.

strange_folk_on_east_road.text: Aye, strange folk on the East Road. Some of them pay well, if you keep your mouth shut.

dwarves_going_east.text: Dwarves go east, aye. Good for trade. Never stop long.
